claims.explanation: The selective killing of vincristine is primarily driven by expression of multidrug resistance efflux transporters (ABCB1/P-gp and ABCC1/MRP1), which lower intracellular drug levels and protect cells. Additionally, high expression of the anti-apoptotic protein MCL1 and loss-of-function mutations in FBXW7, which stabilize MCL1 during mitotic arrest, further protect cells from vincristine-induced apoptosis. This predicts that lines with high ABCB1/ABCC1 expression or MCL1 expression, or FBXW7 mutations, will be resistant, while lines lacking these features will be sensitive.
